# Prezi

> Prezi is an AI-powered presentation software platform that enables users to create engaging, non-linear presentations with design automation, templates, and collaboration features.

Prezi offers solutions for businesses, educators, and students through its core products: Prezi AI (AI presentation maker), Prezi Present (presentation creation), Prezi Design (design tools), and Prezi Video (video integration). The platform integrates with popular tools like Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex, and supports multiple file formats including PPTX and PDF.
